current_revision.mathematical_scope: Metric: common deep collar threshold on all residual copies; full inverse-metric stability with residual covector norm <=sqrt(4/3); smooth integrable majorant and deep cutoff; global length contraction via local single-cell images; proper surjection H composed with Psi; bounded ambient fibers; arbitrary prescribed compact collapsed to the apex with compact-dependent K; basepoint-containing correspondences of distortion <=3K/R for all centers and ball radii. Measure: deep-sector compact upper bounds, full-collar compact-residual ambient-open LDP lower bound, direct one-face exponential tightness, and clean product-cusp counterexample to exact-support restricted lower bounds. Tail: direct level potential, ordered calibration limits, raw residual exponential tails, angular-sector remainder control, threshold inclusions, minimizing-vertex normalization W, joint excess strip and tightness, Laplace coefficient. No new analytic hypothesis on the noncompact ample SNC application.
current_revision.not_verified: No exhaustive audit of facewise measured-GH translation, Chern-Weil/face-mass and Abel-Mellin uniformity, Parts II-III, or the complete external surface theorem. No new proof of family-uniform CP/PBE/TC, H_loc/H_anc, or controlled push-off. No formal proof, external referee review or exhaustive novelty investigation. Existing exact/numerical certificate suites were not rerun.
